scientific_evidence_summary: For turmeric/curcuminoid ingredients, canine osteoarthritis trials have produced mixed results. A 2003 randomized double-blind placebo-controlled trial of the turmeric extract P54FP found no significant difference in peak vertical force, although investigators' overall assessment favored the extract. A 2017 placebo-controlled study of a curcuminoid/collagen/green-tea combination found no significant difference in objective ground-reaction forces, but some pain-related subjective outcomes improved. A 2021 randomized study reported additional benefit signals when a specific Curcuvet/Boswellia combination was added to a conventional nutraceutical. These studies evaluate specific turmeric/curcuminoid extracts or combinations, not this exact turmeric-containing commercial formula.
scientific_limitations: Turmeric products differ in extract chemistry, curcuminoid concentration, bioavailability and dose. The cited studies do not establish efficacy for this ASIN or for turmeric as used in its complete formula.
